name: fff-search
description: Floating fuzzy search over your workspace, backed by a resident fff index.

fffSearch.maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches returned per search.

fffSearch.maxMatchesPerFile.description: Maximum matches kept from a single file, so one huge file cannot fill the list.

fffSearch.smartCase.description: Case-insensitive while the query is lowercase, case-sensitive once it contains an uppercase letter. Turn off to always ignore case.

fffSearch.fuzzyFallback.description: Retry a literal search as a fuzzy search when it finds nothing, so typos still return results.

fffSearch.timeBudgetMs.description: Wall-clock budget per search in milliseconds. grep runs synchronously on the extension host, so a larger budget returns more complete results but blocks the picker for longer.

fffSearch.maxFileSizeMb.description: Files larger than this are skipped.

fffSearch.persistFrecency.description: Store fff's frecency and query history in the extension's global storage, so files you actually open rank higher in later sessions.

fffSearch.preview.description: Preview the highlighted match in the editor behind the picker while moving through results.

fffSearch.seedFromSelection.description: Use the current editor selection as the initial query.
